Ukraine's Former Top General Discusses Russia's Military Capability

Ukraine's former top general, Valeriy Zaluzhnyi, stated in his first interview since leaving his post that Russia's offensive capability is broken. He discussed Ukraine's future in the ongoing war. Separately, Russia claims that former Ukrainian prisoners are voluntarily fighting under Russian command.
